title: Finite negative Koszul tensor stages vanish after residue extension vanishes
statement: Let C be a small site with topology T, R and S commutative ring sheaves, and q:R to S a map surjective on sections on every object. Let b be a finite list of r global R-sections whose values generate ker(q) on every object. For any unbounded cochain complex P of R-module sheaves, suppose its derived extension of scalars along q is zero. Then for every n>=0 the direct-sum total tensor of P with the dual of the ordered positive Koszul complex on the sections b_i^(n+1) is acyclic. The dual is the actual ringedKoszulDualTower stage (Hom from the positive complex into R[0]). No derived-completeness, Noetherianity or cohomological-bound hypothesis is imposed. [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]

proof.text: Choose a termwise-flat K-flat replacement Pprime of P. The existing universal scalar-extension comparison computes ordinary extension on Pprime. Applying derived extension to its quasi-isomorphism into P and using the given zero hypothesis proves that ordinary extension of Pprime is acyclic.
The finite dual Koszul stage is supported in [-r,0], and its homology sheaves are annihilated sectionwise by the (r*(n+1)+1)-st power of the ideal generated by b.

The nilpotent coefficient theorem kills the tensor of Pprime with every homology sheaf of the dual stage placed in degree zero. Apply the proved bounded-homology tensor criterion to obtain acyclicity of Pprime tensor the actual dual stage.

The actual finite dual Koszul stage is K-flat by the existing theorem. Its tensor with the cone of Pprime to P is acyclic. The tensor-cone isomorphism therefore makes tensor of that quasi-isomorphism a quasi-isomorphism; transfer the acyclicity to the displayed tensor with P. This argument also covers the empty list and zero rings.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteKoszulTensor_acyclic_of_residue
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R S : Sheaf T CommRingCat.{u}} (q : R ⟶ S) (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin r → (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (hq : ∀ U : C, Function.Surjective (q.hom.app (op U)))
    (hker : ∀ U : C, RingHom.ker (q.hom.app (op U)).hom =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (b i).val (op U))))
    (P : ringedSiteComplex R)
    (h₀ : IsZero ((ConstantCompletion.extend q).obj ((ConstantCompletion.Q R).obj P)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (((ringedKoszulTensor R).obj P).obj
      ((ringedKoszulDualTower R r b).obj (op n))).Acyclic
